purpose: R1.16.1 — Entity Mentions Correctness: close exactly the THREE independently reproduced R1.16 defects (Posidon probes on production code: 3 failed / 18 skipped / exit 1) WITHOUT starting any next capability. (1) C1 REPORT↔LINK COHERENCE — the R1.16 ALIAS_UNIQOWN predicate made only the link INSERT conditional, so a catalog mutation inside the lookup→commit window left a committed draft whose report claimed entitiesLinked=1 over ZERO durable rows (reproduced: expected 1 to be 0). FIX: a whole-result catalog-mapping gate rides on EVERY statement of the fenced atomic batch — the claimed pairs travel as ONE bound JSON parameter read through json_each with an expected-count parameter (two bound parameters per statement; heaviest statement stays ≤23 of the D1 limit of 100; EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on local workerd D1 seeks idx_entity_alias_lookup per claimed pair, no table scan, LOCAL PROXY only); one invalidated mapping → every statement no-ops → typed catalogChanged classification (the zero-effect classification read gains mappings_hold; precedence snapshot > mappings > fence); the handler re-resolves ONCE against the current catalog with a fresh SQL lookup and the SAME provider draft (no new provider call/charge — replay of the same snapshot gains no new AI effect) and only a second catalogChanged hands the bounded engine retry; the committed report now EQUALS the durable links (multi-alias mentions of one entity dedup through the statement PK guard; the old entity_mention_link_suppressed warning became an entity_mention_link_count_mismatch invariant tripwire against the DISTINCT entity count). Tests/docs that deliberately accepted the weak no-op-only-link contract are corrected WITH the reason recorded (alias REMAPPED case: the commit-time mapping is what both the report and the link say). (2) U1 CODE-POINT TOKENIZER — buildEntityMentionPhrases walked UTF-16 code units, so U+10400DoomU+10400 falsely produced the standalone phrase Doom (astral letters read as separators via lone surrogates). FIX: codePointAt + String.fromCodePoint traversal with correct slice offsets; astral letters/numbers/marks are first-class token characters, unpaired surrogates stay separators, emoji (So) stays a separator; Persian, ZWNJ, NFC, Doomlike/Doom2/Half-Life behavior preserved byte-for-byte; the 256-token cap is enforced DURING traversal (early exit at the first beyond-cap token start) with tokensTruncated as the honest probe. (3) R1 READER AMBIGUITY INVARIANTS — the reader validated (alias, entity) pair ascent, which still accepted one alias resolved to two distinct owners. FIX: strict ALIAS ascent (no duplicate alias in matched), matched/ambiguous disjointness, and the shared candidate-phrase bound (matched + ambiguous ≤ phrasesConsidered); counts/observation/caps/limitations checks and the full malformed/null/primitive/array table are unchanged; no invented alias-format or hash constraints. REUSE BOUNDARY — the accepted R1.15.2 exact-content reuse contract is preserved byte-for-byte: replay/reuse paths still run ZERO alias lookups and ZERO enrichment; historical drafts/reports are never rewritten or backfilled. TESTS: RED recorded on caa7402 with the three probes integrated into the PERMANENT suites (tests/unit/entity-mentions.test.ts exit 1: 5 failed / 38 passed — U1 astral letters, U1 astral digits+marks, R1 two owners, R1 cross-listed, R1 shared bound; tests/integration/entity-mentions.test.ts exit 1: C1 expected 1 to be 0 — REAL workerd D1, REAL engine/handler/store). GREEN: unit 43/43, integration 20/20 (incl. the new EXPLAIN gate-plan probe and the strengthened DELETED/SECOND-OWNER report observations), full npm test 113 files / 1577 tests exit 0 (R1.16 baseline 1569 + 8 net new).
